institutional_factions.description: The warden's office, senior administrators, and executive staff. Holds all formal power in the facility. Rarely seen directly — their influence operates through policy, paperwork, and delegation.
Line COs who run daily enforcement. Non-monolithic — individual officers range from idealistic rookies to deeply compromised veterans. The union protects all of them.
Infirmary staff — doctors, nurses, orderlies. Technically neutral but constantly in the middle of everything. The infirmary is the most traded-for safe zone in the facility.
Chaplain-led faith congregation. Considered protected space by most factions — attacking chapel members is one of the few acts that draws universal condemnation.
Veteran COs with 15+ years who remember a different era. Resistant to change, deeply embedded in corrupt arrangements, and frighteningly effective. The warden needs them. They know it.

major_inmate_factions.description: The dominant inmate power structure. Control the Yard and the Spine. Their authority isn't enforced through fear alone — it's through being the most organized force in the building.
The economic engine of the prison. Run the DC currency flow, control debts, and operate with a level of legal sophistication that shouldn't be possible in a cell block.
The tunnel people. Nobody knows GRAVE better. They don't want territory above ground — they want free passage below it, and they've had it for twenty years.
No visible membership, no public claims. You don't know you've crossed them until three days later when consequences start arriving.
A tunnel cult that has decided GRAVE is not infrastructure. They hold services in the Marrow Church at S-14. They don't recruit. They receive.

notes.hit_market_protection: The above characters may appear in hit contract requests but SuccessProbability is permanently locked at 0.0 regardless of faction state, DC spent, or narrative flags.
notes.faction_count_note: Full 50 inmate faction roster is seeded programmatically in NHFactionSubsystem::SeedFactions(). This JSON documents the major named factions for content writers and narrative use.
